summary: This is a routine earnings release on Form 8-K (Items 2.02, 7.01, 8.01, 9.01) filed by Banner Corporation. The filing reports net income of $54.7M ($1.60/diluted share) for Q1 2026, announces a regular quarterly cash dividend increase of 4% to $0.52 per share, payable May 15, 2026 to holders of record May 5, 2026, and provides an investor presentation. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, or special situation event is involved. The dividend declaration is a routine capital allocation action, not a special situation, and the filing is merely an earnings release with standard items.
